title: Ten t-tests where nothing differs
intro: Five groups give 10 pairs, so comparing every pair takes 10 t-tests. Here each trial runs 10 independent t-tests at α = 0.05, every one on a sample of n = 10 from a population where the null hypothesis is true, and counts how many reject. 1000 trials (seed 1). The event is "at least one of the 10 tests rejects": a false alarm somewhere in the family.
